name: AccuTac Fabrication and Welding, LLC
old_description: Your Vision, Our Accuracy Delivered With High Quality American Craftmanship!
about:
AccuTac Fabrication and Welding, LLC was founded in 2018 in Shelbyville, Kentucky, by Nick Waurio and Derrick Mullins, who serve as the company's owners. The shop began as a welding and fabrication service focused on delivering custom metalwork with an emphasis on accuracy and craftsmanship.

The company provides custom-fabricated handrails, ornamental driveway gates, equipment repair, and industrial welding services. Its welding capabilities include MIG, TIG, and stick processes for mild steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, with field welding and on-site repairs for industrial equipment, ductwork, and large-diameter piping. The shop operates from a facility on 7th Street, though headcount and production volumes are not publicly disclosed.

AccuTac serves a mix of residential, commercial, and industrial clients. Examples include homeowners seeking custom gates and handrails, as well as industrial customers needing repair and maintenance for metal structures, ductwork, and piping systems.

The founders state that the business was built on a commitment to quality services, exceptional efficiency, and the highest level of professionalism, aiming to exceed client expectations on every project.
